scored: DETERMINISTIC ONLY (answer EM/F1, abstention, citation validity/resolution, paragraph-level support F1)
sentence_id_rule: NOT-EMITTED: pipeline cites (title, paragraph), not (title, sentence_id); sentence hits never inferred
comparability_caveat: The draft prompt elicits a full-sentence answer while HotpotQA gold answers are short spans, so absolute EM is structurally near zero and F1 is depressed. The OFF/ON contrast is valid (identical shared drafts); these absolutes are NOT comparable to published HotpotQA leaderboards.

shared_draft_check.note: One draft is generated per (item, repeat) before the fork and both arms consume it; final_answer divergence is the treatment effect, not a draft divergence.
